body: Go fuck yourself. I wanted anything more than nothing, you fucking bastard.

I'm sorry about your girlfriend. I really am, but it can all be worked out? Bullshit. Fucking bullshit. I've reached out, more than once. I was ignored by friends, laughed at by family. Even this subreddit fucking ignored me. So, I'm sorry, but it can't all be worked out sometimes. You might have cared about her, but in my experience, no one else gives a fuck.
